title: Train collides with vehicle on Old Santa Maria Road; both occupants reported okay
excerpt: A train reportedly struck the rear of a vehicle near the 5320 block of Old Santa Maria Road in Laredo on Tuesday evening. Two women were involved, and both were reported to be okay. No injuries were reported.
content:
A train reportedly collided with the rear of a vehicle near the 5320 block of Old Santa Maria Road in Laredo on Tuesday evening, November 10, prompting an emergency response to the area.

According to preliminary information, two women were involved in the incident, and both were reported to be okay following the collision. No injuries were reported.

The circumstances surrounding the crash remain unclear, and additional details have not yet been released. Drivers in the area should expect delays and use caution around the crossing while crews remain on scene.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 10, 2026. Details are preliminary and may change as officials release more information.
